name: writemark-editor
description: Writemark is a dependency-free live inline Markdown editor web component with slash commands, smart editing, form integration, source fallback, and no built-in toolbar.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:fuzz: npm run check && playwright test tests/security.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run check
scripts.check: node scripts/build.mjs --check && node --check src/writemark-editor.js && node --check dist/writemark-editor.js && node --check dist/writemark-editor.global.js && node --check scripts/dev-server.mjs && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/check-docs.mjs && node --check scripts/check-version.mjs && npm run check:version && npm run test:version && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
